rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken description of someone lying face-down.

example.english: He is lying on the floor, completely prostrate.
example.traditional: 佢瞓喺地下，成個人伏喺度。
example.jyutping: keoi5 fan3 hai2 dei6 haa6 sing4 go3 jan4 fuk6 hai2 dou6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for lying flat or face down.

example.english: After a long day, I prostrate myself on the sofa when I get home.
example.traditional: 我做完成日嘢返到屋企，就趴低喺梳化度。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zou6 jyun4 sing4 jat6 je5 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2 zau6 paa1 dai1 hai2 so1 faa2 dou6

rows.note: Use this for someone who is emotionally devastated or unable to cope.

example.english: After hearing the news, they were completely prostrate.
example.traditional: 收到呢個消息之後，佢成個人崩潰咗。
example.jyutping: sau1 dou2 ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 zi1 hau6 keoi5 sing4 go3 jan4 bang1 kui2 zo2

rows.note: Use this when someone throws themselves face down on the ground as an act of submission or humility.

example.english: When they see the emperor, they prostrate themselves on the ground and beg forgiveness.
example.traditional: 佢一見到皇帝，就伏喺地下叩頭請罪。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 gin3 dou2 wong4 dai3 zau6 fuk6 hai2 dei6 haa2 kau3 tau4 cing2 zeoi6

rows.note: Use this for physical collapse or extreme weakness caused by heat, illness, or exhaustion.

example.english: After being out in the heat all day, I was prostrate with exhaustion.
example.traditional: 焗咗成日之後，我攰到虛脫。
example.jyutping: guk6 zo2 seng4 jat6 zi1 hau6 ngo5 gui6 dou3 heoi1 tyut3

rows.note: Use this for flattening an area, structure, or other object completely to the ground.

example.english: A powerful earthquake could prostrate the whole building.
example.traditional: 一場大地震可以將成座大廈夷平。
example.jyutping: jat1 coeng4 daai6 dei6 zan3 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 sing4 zo6 daai6 haa6 ji4 ping4
